author: Mooriie
body:
First off I want to thank the Avicus staff for bearing with my other worthless appeals where I was clearly trying to hide that I was hacking, and bearing with my stupidity, Thanks.

So about a few months ago, or around 2, I got banned for hacking *fly*, Now thinking back to it I was trying to make the most lame excuses ever and was acting like an absolute idiot wasting the staffs time.
I really want to get back on Avicus because there isn't anything more fun on minecraft then Avicus!
I greatly acknowledge my reckless behavior,    *trying to by pass ban* , and my awful thinking for *hacking*.
Getting back on Avicus would mean so much to me because I have quite minecraft because its so boring without Avicus.
I realize that I was ruining the game for other players, and now when I see a hacker in some games I play I just don't think its fun anymore, seeing that I was once one, and on my favorite server (Avicus) I just nod my head at my actions on here.
I will never ever perform these outrageous behaviors and actions on Avicus.
I really think I've learned my lesson from this ban, and it was for good.
Hope fully I can get UN banned and show you how I've improved on my behavior and actions, 
Thank you.
